authority_rules: Authority belongs to stable roles and documented assignments, not names embedded in this registry.
No role may self-approve outside its documented domain; specialist approvals remain independent.
Any person who observes imminent danger may request a stop; designated stage, technical, venue, and safety roles may impose HOLD/STOP/ABORT within assigned competence.
Safety action takes immediate precedence and is never delayed for creative, timing, financial, or release approval.
Developer and generated-system behavior never constitute fact or policy approval.

records.label: Owner / Performer
records.responsibility: May approve owner/business identity and scope when controlled evidence is recorded; cannot replace specialist safety, venue, rights, privacy, or technical authority.

records.label: Production Manager
records.responsibility: Coordinates production and document control; accountable only within assigned and approved production scope.

records.label: Director
records.responsibility: Controls approved creative and performance direction subject to safety and rights constraints.

records.label: Technical Director
records.responsibility: Controls integrated technical planning and verified technical releases; may hold unsafe or unverified technical execution.

records.label: Stage Manager / Show Caller
records.responsibility: Calls approved show actions and propagates HOLD/STOP/ABORT; does not invent or bypass approvals.

records.label: Safety Authority
records.responsibility: May issue HOLD, STOP, ABORT, restrictions, or refusal within assigned competence; this authority overrides timing and creative intent.

records.label: Rights Reviewer
records.responsibility: Reviews ownership, license, consent, affiliation, endorsement, and permitted-use evidence.

records.label: Privacy Steward
records.responsibility: Controls access, minimization, retention, deletion, and escalation for restricted personal data.

records.label: Accessibility Reviewer
records.responsibility: Reviews accessibility requirements, claims, and evidence.

records.label: Venue Representative
records.responsibility: Supplies and approves venue-specific facts within documented authority; relationship is not presumed.

records.label: Developer
records.responsibility: Implements mechanics and validation; has no authority to approve project facts or policy.
